title: Design System: PharmIQ Opportunity Analysis Calculator

display.purpose: Hero opportunity figure / page-defining headline. One per view.

body.purpose: Descriptions, form values, table cells. 16px min on mobile.

label.purpose: Uppercase table headers, eyebrows, button labels.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Small buttons and inline controls at rest.

shadows.name: lg
shadows.purpose: Total/hero card and main working card.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, reveal, and inline status changes. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single teal action per moment (e.g. Generate Plan).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0F766E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Outfit','DM Sans',sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,0.10), 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0D5D5A; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(15,23,42,0.07), 0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F766E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'Outfit','DM Sans',sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,0.10), 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F8FAFC; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(15,23,42,0.07); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F766E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Total / Hero Card
components.description: Navy card carrying the headline opportunity figure in Display type.
components.css: .ds-total-card { background: #0F172A; color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px rgba(15,23,42,0.10), 0 4px 6px rgba(15,23,42,0.05); } .ds-total-label { font-family: 'Outfit','DM Sans',sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #94A3B8; } .ds-total-figure { font-family: 'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem); line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 8px 0 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Number Input
components.description: Current/potential volume field with tabular numerals.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="number" inputmode="numeric" value="120" aria-label="Current volume" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; font-family: 'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #0F766E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,118,110,0.20); }

components.name: Table Header
components.description: Data-table column header — Outfit uppercase label on slate.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table thead { background: #F1F5F9; } .ds-table th { font-family: 'Outfit','DM Sans',sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #94A3B8; text-align: left; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0; } .ds-table td { font-family: 'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #0F172A; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0; } .ds-table .num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: This surface is operational infrastructure, not a brochure. A pharmacist opens it to quantify missed professional-services revenue and leave with a plan, often between dispensing tasks. Every decision serves that job: dense-but-calm data tables, one unmistakable primary action per moment, and a single hero figure that reads as the instrument's output. The system pairs an editorial serif (Fraunces) reserved strictly for the headline moment with a geometric sans (Outfit) doing all the operational heavy lifting, over a restrained slate-neutral canvas. Teal is the one voice of action; amber is scarce and means attention. Depth comes from an adjacent-surface ladder and hairline borders before any heavy shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Operational density with a calm, uncluttered rhythm.
One hero number, one primary action, one accent voice per viewport.
Neutral slate surfaces; color earns its place by carrying status.
Editorial serif for the headline moment only; geometric sans everywhere else.
Depth via surface ladder + hairline borders, not shadow stacks.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only action color. If two elements compete for 'click me' in a viewport, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Scarce Amber Rule
rules.body: If more than one amber element appears at rest in a single viewport, reassess the hierarchy — amber means attention, and attention doesn't scale.

rules.name: The Serif-Once Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears exactly once per view — the hero number or headline. Everywhere else is Outfit or Inter.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All currency and volume figures use tabular/lining numerals so columns align and totals don't jitter as values change.

rules.name: The Ladder-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for the next surface step and a hairline border before adding a shadow. Do not nest cards to fake depth.

dos: Do keep exactly one primary (teal) action per moment and one Fraunces headline per view.
Do use tabular numerals for every currency and volume figure so columns stay aligned.
Do build depth with the surface ladder and hairline borders first; add shadow only for the working card and hover.
Do wrap dense tables in overflow-x-auto and keep 16px minimum input font size on mobile.
Do reserve amber for opportunity/warning and keep it scarce.
Do target WCAG AA, pair color states with text/icon cues, and keep visible focus states.
donts: Don't introduce a second action color or use teal for decoration.
Don't set Fraunces on body, labels, or more than one headline — it's the serif-once voice.
Don't nest cards or stack shadows to fake hierarchy.
Don't let more than one amber element sit at rest in a viewport.
Don't use muted #94A3B8 for informational body text on light surfaces, and don't put white text on amber.
Don't make the tool feel like a generic blue healthcare dashboard — the brand lives in restraint and precise detail.
